source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: An agent says it assembled your report, results, and revised skill into one file. You open it and find the revised skill is missing. How should you evaluate the work?

options.text: As complete because the message lists the required components
options.feedback: Listing materials in a message does not establish that they appear in the artifact. Your inspection reveals a missing requirement.

options.text: As complete because the existing report is readable
options.feedback: Readability is useful, but the required contents also matter. The requested package must include the revised skill.

options.text: As incomplete because required material is missing
options.feedback: Evaluate the artifact against the task. Ask for the omitted skill to be included, then inspect the repaired package.

options.text: As complete because the skill exists elsewhere in the project
options.feedback: An available source file is not the same as its inclusion in the requested package. Verify the actual deliverable contains the intended materials.
